fato_historico: 117: Hadrian is proclaimed Roman emperor, two days after Trajan's death.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos suggests you may be standing on the threshold of a new personal kingdom today. Much like a bold leader stepping into a grand mantle, you might feel the weight and the glory of your own potential. It is a good time to claim your space and trust the legacy you are building with steady hands.
frase_do_dia: Rise into your own power with grace and steady, unwavering determination.
significado_numero: A powerful gateway for manifestation and aligning with your higher purpose.
conselho: Trust your intuition as you step into a position of greater self-leadership.
